generation.scope: For any pure-free six-plane of relations, the binary quotient with prescribed kernel line is recognized by an integral rank-one curve spanning both factors after projection. Its unique rank-one scheme is a rational normal quintic. Matching vertex curves give a four-window exponential-growth certificate even with nontrivial PGL2 monodromy.

proof_review.scope: Proved the equality case of the function-space product bound, intrinsic recovery of the projection kernel and unordered curve data, and propagation of identifications along the integer line.

mathematical_computation.scope: Compared the ten quadratic generators of the rank-one Hankel scheme and verified four edge spans with an explicit nonidentity return on the parameter line.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Determine the codimension and generic recoverability of a single-edge binary quotient, then compare its rank-two determinantal curves with explicit non-bisymmetric windows.
